title: Render field-declared matrix dimensions
problem: A generic matrix result declares facet_field, x_field, y_field, value_field and coverage_field in style_hint, but the current consumer matrix renderer recognises only payload columns named row/entity and col/place/time. Valid producer matrices therefore fall back to a summary card.
requested_outcome: Read matrix dimension and value field names from layer.style_hint.
Retain the current row/col conventions as a backwards-compatible fallback.
Support a declared facet as small multiples, a selector, or another responsive generic treatment.
Use no site, sector or source-specific vocabulary in renderer dispatch.
producer_evidence: dss/visual_index/result_service.py matrix-profile emits category, x, y, value, series and unit.
The matrix layer declares facet_field=category, x_field=x, y_field=y, value_field=value and coverage_field=series.
The producer integration suite validates the result against idli-result/1.
acceptance: A fixture whose fields are category/x/y/value renders as a matrix rather than a summary card.
Two or more facets remain distinguishable on desktop and mobile.
Missing cells, value scale, unit and contributing-series coverage remain inspectable.
Existing row/col matrix fixtures continue to render.
The accepted fixture contains no organisation or sector data.
notes: This proposal asks only for generic consumer interpretation of already-declared fields. It does not ask Idlisseus to know how the matrix was scientifically produced.
